```suggestion
        .value_name("JOBS")
```

This `unwrap()` could result in a panic if the value is unparsable.
I would suggest using the `?` syntax to early-return if unparsable.
```rust
let num_of_jobs = arguments.value_of("jobs")
    .unwrap_or("0")
	.parse::<u64>()
    .ok()?;
```
